Reading.title: Blood Sugar Reading
Reading.description: A single blood sugar measurement at a specific time.

userId.description: The UID of the user who owns this reading

AccessRequest.title: Access Request
AccessRequest.description: A request from a guest to view an owner's data.

SharedPermission.title: Shared Permission
SharedPermission.description: Record of granted access from owner to guest.

/readings/{readingId}.description: Collection of blood sugar readings. Read only if owner or authorized guest.
/readings/{readingId}.rules: allow read: if request.auth != null && (resource.data.userId == request.auth.uid || exists(/databases/$(database)/documents/permissions/$(request.auth.token.email + '_' + resource.data.userId))); allow write: if request.auth != null && request.resource.data.userId == request.auth.uid;

/requests/{requestId}.description: Guest access requests. Read only if owner or requester.
/requests/{requestId}.rules: allow read, write: if request.auth != null && (request.auth.token.email == resource.data.requesterEmail || request.auth.token.email == resource.data.ownerEmail);

/permissions/{permissionId}.rules: allow read: if request.auth != null && (request.auth.token.email == resource.data.guestEmail || request.auth.uid == resource.data.ownerUid); allow write: if request.auth != null && request.auth.uid == request.resource.data.ownerUid;
